motions.name: Page entrance
motions.purpose: Provide continuity when navigating without changing layout.

motions.name: Section reveal
motions.effect: 12px rise and fade, once as the section enters view.
motions.purpose: Guide scanning through long pages, without hiding content permanently.
motions.trigger: Scroll to section; Replay remounts reveals.
motions.reduced: Fully visible immediately; no scroll-triggered animation.

motions.name: Card / action response
motions.location: Event, role, format and resource cards; action wrappers
motions.effect: Card rises 3px; buttons press to 0.98 scale.
motions.purpose: Confirm a deliberate hover, keyboard focus or press.
motions.trigger: Hover/focus within a card; pointer press on action.
motions.reduced: No movement; native focus outline retained.

motions.name: Active navigation marker
motions.effect: Cyan underline slides between active routes using shared layoutId.
motions.trigger: Choose a different site navigation route.
motions.reduced: Marker switches instantly; aria-current still identifies route.

motions.name: Mobile menu content entrance
motions.effect: Inner navigation fades and moves in 12px from the right.
motions.purpose: Explain the menu opening while preserving focus management.
motions.trigger: Menu button; Open menu demo in review controls.
motions.timing: 220ms ease-out. Sheet itself uses no additional CSS motion.
motions.reduced: Instant menu content; focus containment and Escape unchanged.

motions.name: Dialog content entrance
motions.location: Attendance, membership, resource and enquiry dialogs
motions.effect: Contents fade and scale 0.985→1; overlay and dialog position remain stable.
motions.purpose: A small response when a deliberate detail action opens.
motions.timing: 180ms ease-out, no exit animation delaying dismissal.

motions.name: Action feedback transition
motions.effect: Status crossfade with a 4px rise; optional busy icon rotates only while busy.
motions.purpose: Make changed state legible without implying an external transaction.
motions.timing: 200ms ease-out; simulated busy state 600ms; icon 800ms linear during that interval.
motions.reduced: Immediate state text; no spinner rotation or crossfade.

motions.name: Disclosure height transition
motions.effect: Answer expands to natural height and opacity; collapses to zero.
motions.purpose: Maintain context while opening a concise answer/document summary.
motions.reduced: Instant open/closed state; content remains semantically hidden when closed.

motions.name: One-pass border shine
motions.effect: Blue/cyan radial border highlight moves once around the panel.
motions.purpose: A restrained optional emphasis for a single important next step.
motions.trigger: Page entry or Replay / Play demo.
motions.timing: 6s linear; one iteration; 1.5px masked border; no repeating background.
motions.reduced: ShineBorder is not mounted. The static panel border remains.

motions.name: Resource spotlight
motions.effect: A soft cyan spotlight follows pointer position or focused descendant.
motions.purpose: An optional exploratory response; assess it against the plain card.
motions.trigger: Pointer movement or Tab into card; locate with Play demo.
motions.timing: Upstream requestAnimationFrame smoothing 0.3; no ambient, flare or grain. Focus tracking included upstream.
motions.reduced: SpotlightCard unmounted; identical plain card wrapper. Pointer-only effects also skipped for coarse pointers.

motions.name: Filtered-card layout transition
motions.effect: Cards fade out/in and remaining results shift into their new layout.
motions.purpose: Help track a changed result set.
motions.trigger: Tabs, search or example event-state controls.
motions.timing: 180ms opacity and 240ms layout ease-out; keyed records, no artificial loading delay.
motions.reduced: Immediate filtered results; count is announced.

motions.name: Bounded scoped sequence
motions.effect: Three ordered nodes reveal briefly; a user-triggered signal follows explicit keyframes with one reverse repeat.
motions.purpose: Demonstrate accepted Motion capabilities in a bounded, cancellable example.
motions.trigger: Run bounded sequence; visibility and document state gate work; unmount cancels it.
motions.timing: 40ms child stagger; signal 650ms with one reverse repeat, then stops.
motions.reduced: Nodes and explanation are static; the optional Run action is unavailable when motion is suppressed.

motions.name: Supplementary folder opening
motions.effect: Genuine matte React Bits folder opens/closes through the external labelled button.
motions.purpose: Compare a supplementary collection illustration with its static alternative while keeping every document visible.
motions.trigger: Open/Close folder illustration; no drag or autoplay intro.
motions.timing: Upstream spring settles after each deliberate open/close; no ambient loop or glass renderer.
motions.reduced: The Folder component is unmounted; a static Lucide icon and always-visible controls/list remain.

motions.name: Scoped reading position
motions.effect: Reader-scoped Magic UI bar follows scroll with a settling spring and derived width.
motions.purpose: Indicate location in a bounded reader without implying comprehension.
motions.trigger: Scroll inside the walkthrough reader in Animated mode.
motions.timing: Spring stiffness 300, damping 40; settles after input stops.
motions.reduced: Animated component unmounted. Native progress and immediate text percentage remain.

motions.name: Source-to-export explanation
motions.effect: Draw a line then move one signal through three labelled stages.
motions.purpose: Explain this source project workflow; no command executes.
motions.trigger: Play build explanation, when visible in Animated mode.
motions.timing: 700ms path drawing, then 800ms signal; one pass. Stop, visibility, reduced motion and unmount cancel work.
motions.reduced: Static SVG and numbered text sequence remain; Play unavailable.

policy: Static mode and system/review reduced motion disable all optional effects. React Bits is also skipped for coarse pointers. All proposed effects have an implemented preview.
